item.title: A State of Trance (ASOT) heads to Asia with first-ever Vietnam festival & debut Hong Kong stop this June
item.description: A State of Trance (ASOT) — the globally influential trance brand founded by Armin van Buuren — is making a major move into Asia, with two landmark debuts confirmed for June: its first-ever festival in Vietnam and its first official ASOT event in Hong Kong. Together, the back-to-back shows mark a significant expansion of ASOT’s global footprint, bringing one of trance music’s most respected institutions to two of Asia’s most vibrant cities. item.title: DAY6 to bring ‘The DECADE’ 10th anniversary world tour to Singapore this April
item.description: DAY6 are making their long-awaited return to Singapore — and this time, they’re going big. The beloved K-pop pop-rock band will celebrate a decade of music with DAY6 10th Anniversary Tour <The DECADE> in SINGAPORE, happening on Saturday, 18 April at the Singapore Indoor Stadium. This marks the band’s first-ever arena-scale concert in the country — a major step up from their sold-out 2024 show at The Star Theatre.
